verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own cap-table page says users can "configure vesting schedules for founders and employees" [eqvista-docs-10], and the Freemium plan lists ESOP management [eqvista-docs-7]. This shows vesting configuration exists, but the evidence never describes cliffs, milestone-based vesting, acceleration on exit, or automatic tracking of vested versus unvested amounts. Missing for 10: cliff configuration, milestone/performance vesting, single/double-trigger acceleration, automatic vested/unvested tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
